pages.title: The traveller's armor
pages.text: 'This armor wasn't always so sturdy.' The old adventurer patted his chestplate and took a scorched book from his pack.$(br2)'Each time you forge it, your gear gains a little something. What that will be, even I can't say.'

pages.title: New strength
pages.text: Powerful creatures and Bosses sometimes leave these books behind.$(br2)Place the book, your equipment and a Nether Star in a smithing table to give the equipment new strength. Each enhancement uses one infusion; an infusion book can replenish it.
